Container.Name: shelf
Container.Overview: Small, fast web file manager with a thumbnail gallery and a fullscreen viewer for pictures and videos.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: The share or folder to browse. Pick one share (for example /mnt/user/media) rather than all of /mnt/user if you can.

Config.Name: Thumbnail cache
Config.Description: Where thumbnails are kept. Safe to delete.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Login name. Leave Username or Password empty to run with no login.

Config.Name: Read-only
Config.Description: Set to 1 to disable uploads and all changes.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns uploaded files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns uploaded files (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 000 gives the same open permissions Unraid shares use.
